settings.content: Content for the info popup opened from the shaping level meter on product cards.

settings.label: Popup content
settings.default:
We created the “Shaping Level Meter” as an easy visual tool to help you identify which Cloudz has the exact amount of shaping you're looking for!

Level 1: Ultra-light shaping. Smooths everything, helps prevent nip-show, and provides barely-there shaping.

Level 2: Light shaping. Provides light, everyday shaping. They help create a natural looking shape, fills for mild breast volume loss, and balances up to 1/2 cup difference.

Level 3: Medium shaping. Fuller and more defined shaping to help smooth divots, fill moderate breast volume loss, and balance up to 3/4 a cup. Also ideal for post-lumpectomy or explant balancing or filling upper breast region for flat-top implants.

Level 4: Max shaping. Delivers our highest level of lift and enhancement to boost sagging, create natural fullness, and restore a perkier silhouette without looking overdone.

Level 5: Complete shaping. Lightweight (1-2 oz.), breathable, and hug friendly breast forms. Designed for women post-mastectomy without breast reconstruction or significant asymmetry.
